props.hookQuestion: Negosyo mo pa ba ang pinapatakbo mo?

training.headline: Your team + AI, working together.
training.body: Setup, integration, and staff enablement by Automatika.

cta.headline: Focus On Growth. We Run The Tech.

scenes.title: Pattern interrupt
scenes.spoken: Wait! Business owner ka ba? Tanong ko lang: Negosyo mo pa ba ang pinapatakbo mo... o ikaw na lang ang tagapag-ayos ng sirang tools at chatbot araw-araw?

scenes.title: Founder frustration
scenes.spoken: Imbes na benta at fulfillment ang asikasuhin, nauubos ang oras mo sa magulong inventory at staff na laging nalilito sa system.

scenes.title: Pancake ecosystem setup
scenes.spoken: Pahinga ka na diyan. As an Official Partner of Pancake Philippines, kami sa Automatika ang magse-set up ng lahat—CRM, Webcake, Botcake AI, at POS mo.

scenes.title: Staff enablement
scenes.spoken: Ite-train pa namin ang team mo to work hand-in-hand with AI. Para makatutok ka sa totoong operasyon, hindi sa maintenance.

scenes.title: Dual CTA
scenes.spoken: Bawiin mo na ang oras mo. Comment 'OPS' o i-click ang link to book your onboarding today!
